mix.method: This county's usual crop changes over its last 5 USDA crop maps, assuming its corn and soybean area stays about the same. reasons.text: About 17% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with a hot July (corn flowering), corn yields here tend to be about 33 bu/ac lower.
In years with a dry July, corn yields here tend to be about 4 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -37 bu/ac in 2011 to about -2 bu/ac in 2014.

twins_note.text: Counties like yours: 5. Their corn yield: 132–192 bu/ac (typical 161). Similar soil and weather doesn't guarantee the same result.
